event.text: You can manage this at home for now. A mild scratchy throat of one day, without fever or difficulty swallowing, is usually a self-limited viral irritation, and simple soothing measures such as fluids, lozenges or gargling often help. If you develop difficulty breathing, noisy breathing at rest, or you cannot swallow your own saliva, call 911 or go to an emergency department immediately. If instead you develop new trouble swallowing, severe one-sided throat or neck pain or swelling, or a muffled voice, arrange clinician assessment the same day. If it simply persists beyond about a week without those changes, a routine clinician review is reasonable.
